Streaming data engineering is essential for high-growth healthcare tech companies. In this post, we'll dive deep into managing stateful stream processing jobs in PySpark. 

**Why:** Managing streaming jobs with complex stateful operators and streaming state stores is challenging. Handling stateful jobs enables continuous, real-time processing of healthcare data. 

**How:** GraphQL and SparkSQL in PySpark facilitate querying state storage and using Structured State DB for better resource utilisation. Best practices include parameterizing and caching state.

**Takeaway:** Efficiency and cost savings in healthcare data processing using PySpark, GraphQL, SparkSQL, and Structured State DB with best practices for stateful streaming jobs management.
